approved.name: Bravura
approved.provenance_note: Developed by Steinberg for Dorico and maintained as the reference font for Standard Music Font Layout (SMuFL); upstream preserves source, FONTLOG and OFL materials.

approved.name: Weather Icons
approved.provenance_note: Weather, maritime and meteorological icon font originally designed by Lukas Bischoff and expanded/maintained by Erik Flowers; upstream documents OFL licensing and API mappings.

approved.name: Flow Circular
approved.provenance_note: Dan Ross / HYPD project designed to abstract content for wireframes and prototypes while preserving text mass; OFL and upstream project metadata preserved.

approved.name: Wavefont
approved.provenance_note: Dmitry Ivanov variable data-rendering font with Round, Vertical Alignment and Weight axes; intended for waveforms, spectra, diagrams and bars; upstream OFL/source metadata preserved.

approved.name: Libre Barcode 39 Extended Text
approved.provenance_note: Libre Barcode project led by Lasse Fister; machine-readable Code 39 family with human-readable text, OFL and documentation preserved upstream.

approved.name: VT323
approved.provenance_note: Peter Hull reconstruction from DEC VT320 terminal glyphs, deliberately modeling CRT pixel aspect and phosphor smear rather than generic square-pixel nostalgia; OFL preserved.

approved.name: Comic Neue
approved.provenance_note: Craig Rozynski reinterpretation of Comic Sans intended to retain casual honesty while regularizing the forms; OFL and project source preserved.

search_feedback: Keep widening visual and historical lanes without turning every batch into either conventional text families or specialist symbol systems. Additive library; no replacement/finalization pressure.
